name: CSWA 31 (Hubble)
blurb: CSWA 31, a galaxy group that acts as a gravitational lens, seen by Hubble.
label: cswa31-hubble
story: An ultra-massive elliptical galaxy sits at the heart of a galaxy group whose gravity, dominated by dark matter toward its center, bends the light of more distant galaxies into giant arcs, the brightest made by a face-on spiral far behind.

claims.text: The lens is a galaxy group whose brightest group galaxy is an ultra-massive elliptical
The group is strongly dark-matter dominated toward its center
The central galaxy is surrounded by giant lensed arcs; the brightest is formed by a face-on spiral
The field is CSWA 31 (lens center RA 09:21:25.738, Dec +18:10:17.70; HST program GO-15253, F438W and F160W)
